question: Does the Philadelphia Fed ADS business conditions index provide original real-time vintage bytes spanning the 2011-2022 Stage1 training and 2023-2026 reused diagnostic periods, for a materially distinct broad-activity signal beyond Stage1's price/VIX/breadth inputs?
economic_mechanism: A real-time broad activity nowcast combining jobless claims, payrolls, production, income, sales and GDP may distinguish systemic demand deterioration from a semiconductor-only decline. This is source qualification, not a cash switch or predictive claim.
fixed_read: One HTTP/1.1 native curl GET of the exact official All vintages ZIP. Save response headers, UTC request/receive times, byte size and SHA-256 before inspecting ZIP members. Preserve exact bytes to Yanxuan NAS, verify remote archive SHA and one scoped byte restore. Inspect only member names, sizes, format and date fields; no market labels or factor values in this preflight.
source_caveats: The official page says the ADS index is updated as underlying economic indicators arrive or revise; a current vintage must not be substituted for the past.
A vintage date alone does not certify exact intraday first availability; later source-clock qualification is required.
A broad macro activity signal is not the same as the already failed G.17 semiconductor production or FT-900 export coordinate; any Stage1 increment must be separately frozen and tested.
acceptance: Official ZIP under 10,000,000 bytes with safe readable members, a parseable vintage-date identity range reaching training and reused held eras, and NAS remote SHA plus scoped byte readback. Source-only success cannot authorize any model or account.
stop: If GET fails, bytes are not a safe ZIP, vintage identities are absent, or NAS restore fails, preserve the concrete dependency and stop this fixed source version. No URL/format fallback, data purchase, SOXX return read or 0bp account.
